newsitem.title: CHINA: Mobil opens China lubricating plant.
newsitem.headline: Mobil opens China lubricating plant.

text.p: Mobil Corp inaugurated its first major investment in China on Saturday with the formal opening of a $45 million lubricant plant in the northern port city of Tianjin.
Company officials told reporters at the opening ceremony that the plant had an annual capacity of 300,000 barrels of lubricant and 40,000 barrels of grease.

George Good, chairman of Mobil Oil China Investment Co Ltd, Mobil's holding company for its China operations, said the plant would import base oil and sell its finished products domestically to meet expanding local demand.
"We believe there is a fast growing market for the type of products we have," Good told reporters. "Demand is not being met by local plants."
Good also said Mobil was building another plant in the southeastern province of Jiangsu.

That plant would have an annual capacity of about 500,000 barrels of lubricant on completion in September and would involve an investment of about the same size as the Tianjin plant, Mobil officials said.
Good said the Tianjin plant was wholly owned by Mobil and Chinese officials welcomed foreign ownership in this segment of the market.
"The lubricant market is not controlled by the government," Good said. "They were happy to have us.
Asked whether there were any preconditions for the investment Good said Mobil had only promised to bring state of the art technology to China.
